_source: Measured from the live app at commit f82f676, rendered headless (SwiftShader) at 900x1400 dpr2. Colour from the 560x560 canvas crop; shader/layout figures read from presets.ts, constants.ts and useFabricControls.ts; overlay matrix read from the live DOM.
_near_white_note: Derived, not directly sampled: total near-white measured 1.323% on sparkle and 0.887% on calm, which has no glitter. Difference attributed to specular, assuming the shared white type contributes equally.
_marker_note: stroke = strokeRatio 0.38 x min half-extent 0.175; slope band = falloffRatio 0.63 x falloff 0.07.
